behaviour.title: The routed arms are not equivalent - the 'standard' arm takes no action of its own
behaviour.detail: Route by Work Type splits the run. The 'priority' arm ends at Fast-Track 'priority' + Alert, which posts a Slack message to #inbox-ops. The 'standard' arm goes to Delegate 'standard' to Sub-workflow, which calls the included sub-workflow lib: Process Standard Email - that sub-workflow normalises the item and tags it with the route, but performs no action of its own, so the branch completes and nothing is sent, filed or updated for it. Add the handling you want inside lib: Process Standard Email before relying on that arm.
